title: DoDonPachi II - Bee Storm
note: Shoot'em up by IGS under Cave's licence (PGM): credits, lives, lives_p2, stage, bombs_p2, bombs, power, power_p2, combo, combo_p2 (FinalBurn Neo and MAME cheat databases). Made by tools/cave_games.py.

retroarch.note: FinalBurn Neo core: PGM 68000 RAM from 0x800000 (128 KB), bytes swapped within 16-bit words

lives.note: lives (FBNeo cheat database, Infinite Lives PL1)

lives_p2.note: lives of player 2 (FBNeo cheat database, Infinite Lives PL2)

stage.note: stage, the value read plus one (FBNeo cheat database, Select Current Stage)

bombs_p2.note: bombs of player 2 (FBNeo cheat database, Infinite Bombs (Bomb) PL2)

bombs.note: bombs of player 1, 5 at most (FBNeo cheat database, Infinite Bombs (Bomb) PL1)

power.note: shot level of player 1, 4 at most (FBNeo cheat database, Maximum Fire Power PL1)

power_p2.note: shot level of player 2 (FBNeo cheat database, Maximum Fire Power PL2)

combo.note: combo gauge of player 1, full = 0x40 (FBNeo cheat database, Infinite Combo Gauge PL1)

combo_p2.note: combo gauge of player 2, full = 0x40 (FBNeo cheat database, Infinite Combo Gauge PL2)

score.note: player 1 score, not in the cheat databases: learn it with learn.bat (score=...)

score_p2.note: player 2 score, learn it with learn.bat in a two-player game (score2=...)

activity.note: no BIOS says who plays: player 1 plays while these values move, as long as one of the moving ones is read (lives or bombs alone change too seldom)
